subject: Action lane: MAP sprint backlog and security gating (SOC 2 / SIG-CAIQ / DPA / retention)
messages:
From: Emma Wright <emma.wright@maplebank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@maplebank.com, procure@maplebank.com
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Kickoff: MAP draft and security gates

Jordan — thanks for the quick intro earlier. Attached is our internal MAP draft (MapleBank-MAP-draft.xlsx) showing milestones procurement and security want to see before go-live. High level asks from our side as we start the MAP: 

- Confirm scope of SOC 2 evidence we can rely on (attestation + system description).
- SIG-CAIQ matrix: we'd like Redwood to fill high-risk items and ownership.
- DPA redline window — procurement wants a target turnaround for redlines and signature.
- Data retention and residency: we need a clear proposal (default 90 days session logs, backups 12 months) and KMS responsibilities.

Can we get an initial proposed gating timeline by EOD Monday? Procurement will need the DPA timeline to line up approvals. Security copied to add anything I missed.

Thanks,
Emma Wright
Senior PM, Maple Bank
Attachments: MapleBank-MAP-draft.xlsx
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Wright <emma.wright@maplebank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP draft and security gates

Emma — really appreciate the clear MAP. I reviewed the spreadsheet and sketched an initial action lane. Quick answers up-front, then a proposed cadence below. Attachments: Redwood-MAP-template.xlsx (our standard), SOC2-summary.pdf (what we share publicly).

Short answers:
- SOC 2: We can provide the most recent Type II attestation and the system description. Security team can walk through control mappings if needed.
- SIG/CAIQ: Redwood will complete the CAIQ baseline and mark any compensating controls; we propose a joint review session to split ownership.
- DPA: We can return a redline within 7 business days for standard clauses; extended SLR/KMS carveouts may take longer.
- Retention/residency: We support US residency by default; proposed retention policy: ephemeral request logs 90 days; backups retained up to 12 months with documented purge process.

Proposed near-term delivery: 
1) Monday (2027-01-25): Redwood to share populated SIG-CAIQ CSV + updated MAP (Milestone A).
2) By 2027-02-01: DPA redline returned to procurement (Milestone B).
3) By 2027-02-08: SOC2 walkthrough + evidence list (Milestone C).
4) By 2027-02-15: Final sign & limited production pilot (Milestone D).

Laura — can you own the SOC2 / CAIQ packing? Ben — can you coordinate commercial acceptance (SLA/credits) if procurement pushes? Emma — does that rough timeline align with your procurement window?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood-MAP-template.xlsx; SOC2-summary.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emma Wright <emma.wright@maplebank.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 13:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP draft and security gates

Thanks for the context, Emma / Jordan. I'll own the SOC 2 and SIG/CAIQ deliverables. A few specifics I want on record so we have a clean acceptance gate in the MAP: 

SOC 2 (acceptance gate):
- Provide PDF of latest Type II attestation + control coverage matrix tied to Redwood services used by Maple Bank.
- Deliver list of evidence owners and expected artifacts (logs, configuration snapshots, change control docs).
- Walkthrough session (30–45m) to answer any contextual questions.

SIG-CAIQ (acceptance gate):
- Redwood will complete CAIQ items we own and flag items that require customer-side controls (e.g., local encryption at rest for exported data).
- We will annotate each flagged item with mitigation or compensating control.
- Joint review session to align on open items and ownership.

DPA / retention specifics I need clarified before we finalize the MAP:
- Who will hold KMS keys for customer data-at-rest? (Redwood-managed vs customer-managed HSM/KMS).
- Retention windows and purge certification cadence (we can provide purge logs on request).
- Any regulatory / contractual requirements for backups / eDiscovery beyond the 12-month backup window.

Timeline feasibility: We can deliver populated CAIQ and an evidence list by 2027-01-25 if you can confirm the KMS preference and any special retention carveouts by Monday. DPA redline turnaround target of 7 business days is reasonable for our standard DPA. If procurement requires countersigned obligations (e.g., escrow or extended SLA), add 1–2 weeks.

I'll prepare the CAIQ CSV and an evidence intake sheet for your security team.

- Laura (Director, Security & Compliance)
From: Emma Wright <emma.wright@maplebank.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@maplebank.com, security@maplebank.com
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 15:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP draft and security gates

Thanks Laura — that looks good. Procurement constraints and clarifications from our side: 
- Procurement goal: have DPA signed by 2027-02-05 to hit vendor approval board.
- KMS: Maple Bank prefers customer-managed keys in a cloud KMS (AWS KMS) for any persisted customer data; we will accept Redwood-managed keys for ephemeral caches only.
- Residency: US-only for production data (exceptions require legal approval).
- Retention: Session/transcript logs 90 days; backups 12 months; we need a clause guaranteeing secure deletion and a quarterly purge report for the first year.
- Escrow / SLA: procurement will flag extended SLA credits during commercial review if we move to production prior to SOC2 control closing.

Attaching a short doc with the procurement constraints: MapleBank-Data-Reqs.docx

I'll confirm by Monday any additional legal carveouts; procurement copied for visibility.

Emma Wright
Senior PM, Maple Bank
Attachments: MapleBank-Data-Reqs.docx
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Wright <emma.wright@maplebank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 09:17:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP draft and security gates — Proposed MAP sprint backlog (updated)

Emma / team — thanks for the confirm. Per the thread and our attachments, here is the agreed MAP sprint backlog and acceptance gates (I pasted the key milestones so procurement/security have a single reference). I've also added who owns each deliverable and the target dates below. I'll upload the updated MAP file (Redwood-MAP-template.xlsx) to the HubSpot record and share the link.

MAP sprint backlog (summary):
- Milestone A (2027-01-25): Redwood delivers populated SIG-CAIQ CSV + evidence intake sheet — owner: Laura Bennett. Acceptance: CAIQ items populated and annotated; evidence intake accepted by Maple security.
- Milestone B (2027-02-01): Redwood returns DPA redline — owner: Jordan Blake. Acceptance: DPA redline provided to procurement; target review complete within 7 business days.
- Milestone C (2027-02-08): SOC2 walkthrough + evidence list delivered — owner: Laura Bennett. Acceptance: Maple security to confirm evidence footprint covers controls in-scope.
- Milestone D (2027-02-15): Production pilot sign-off and limited go-live — owner: Ben Carter. Acceptance: Procurement & Security sign off; SLA placeholders for pilot; escrow / credits to be negotiated if full SOC2 closure pending.

Open items to resolve (action owners):
1) KMS mode: Maple to confirm AWS KMS customer-managed by 2027-01-27 (owner: Emma).
2) Quarterly purge reporting clause: Redwood to propose sample report format by 2027-01-28 (owner: Jordan / Security).
3) DPA redline exceptions: Jordan to flag any non-standard obligations requiring legal escalation.

Links: HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/00000000/record/12345678
DocuSign draft (procurement): https://www.docusign.com/link/abcde-12345

Next steps: Laura will upload CAIQ + evidence sheet by EOD 1/25. Jordan will deliver initial DPA redline by 2/1. Emma — let us know if the 2/5 vendor board date changes.

Thanks — I will keep the MAP live and update the Milestone status as items close.

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: Redwood-MAP-template.xlsx; SOC2-summary.pdf
